sentences.en: Juha sat with friends in the evening.
They wanted to laugh at him a little.
One said: we have a game.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כל אחד ישים ביצה.
sentences.en: He said: each one will put an egg.
He said: we shall put them in water.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: מי שאין לו, משלם.
sentences.en: He said: whoever does not have one, pays.
Everyone brought an egg from his pocket.
Juha did not have an egg.
They laughed and looked at him.
Juha got up and stood a moment.
And then he crowed like a cock.
He crowed very loudly in the room.
Juha said: it is very simple.
He said: everyone here is a hen.
He said: and they bring eggs.
He said: and I am your cock.
